1.description:
ANATOL (late 20s) runs through downtown Hamburg, energetically pulling a rolling suitcase behind him, a backpack on the Back, frantically searching for his destination on Google Maps. He is asking passers-by for directions over a few different cuts.

CUT, Anatol has found the Henri Nannen School, hurries across the street, gets honked at, “sorry sorry sorry...”
1.problems: how tight is the camera - can we boom?

2.description: Anatol runs up the stairs of the journalism school, taking two steps at a time, laden with a suitcase and backpack. He runs excitedly down a corridor, looking for the application room. He finds it. He throws open the door. A three-member panel looks up: a distinguished examiner in his late fifties, an older examiner with anthroposophical leanings, and a brisk younger examiner. Anatol, out of breath, happy. He introduces himself. He walks further into the room, takes off his backpack and continues talking, very quickly, dynamically: The seated examination committee, who looked at him somewhat irritatedly during his monologue, gave polite nods; he laughed at them: they talk for a quarter page.

3.notes: character names not mentioned but characters are described. cable anyone with dialogue on set.
3.description:
Anatol sits waiting, nervous. He looks at a poster on the wall depicting a fight between a tiger and a buffalo in the wild, a scene painted by Rousseau.
He looks at it. Exhales. Trys to relax. He's interrupted: He hears another applicant leave... thanking him... "That was great..." He hears the coordinator: "Yeah, it's crazy... everything can change in a day like that... a whole life..." He's called: "Mr. Baumgarth?"

4.description: Anatol is now expectantly in the intake interview: They have a lengthy conversation (2.5 pages), likely all sitting in chairs.

5.notes: walk and talk. amatol grabs food at the end
5.description:
A cheerful, slightly eccentric coordinator leads Anatol through the corridor:
COORDINATOR 
So, this should be quick now, you'll know this week…
ANATOL 
Ah wow, so fast already?
COORDINATOR
And as they always say, " Don't call us, we'll call you..." Although— if we call, it's a good sign—the rejections come by email...
ANATOL
(laughs somewhat nervously) Ah, then I hope for a phone call..

The coordinator does not address this and refers to the Buffet where mountains of focaccia and Franzbrötchen are laid out:
COORDINATOR 
So, please, help yourselves...
ANATOL
Ah great, thank you - (carefully reaches in)
COORDINATOR 
More, take more -- otherwise it all gets thrown away! I cry hot tears every time...

Anatol obeys and, half-gratefully and half-out of politeness, puts several Franzbrötchen (a type of sweet roll) and tomato focaccia into his already overflowing backpack.

6.description: Anatol sits on the floor of the corridor in the crowded train on the way back to Ebersberg. In front of him is a spread-out newspaper and on his lap an open laptop. He is typing an article for the Ebersberger Merkur: “Dog years. Loneliness. The pet as a fetish in times of demographic change.” Completely focused, in his element.

7.description:
Anatol, as a roving reporter, interviews a dog groomer who is washing a dog with motivation and genuine interest. Around her are certificates, dog hair products and pictures from dog shows, as well as a graphic entitled “From Wolf to Lap Dog”. The dog groomer is monologuing, Anatol is recording and writing along: they talk for 1/3 page. 

She says this and goes next door. Anatol wants to follow, but an excited dog next to him won't leave him alone, rummaging in his backpack with its snout. To calm the animal down, he discreetly gives it the tomato focaccia from journalism school. The dog groomer comes again, Anatol smiles at her. They continue talking.

She mentions how she started her business at a young age. Anatol is now on the defensive. While she starts blow-drying the dog, he tries to shout over her and justifies himself: His smartphone vibrates as he records her. It's the coordinator of the journalism school. The dog groomer, completely absorbed in her work, doesn't notice how he signals to her that he needs to answer the phone.
7.problems: Washing could be louder than dialogue

8.description:
Anatol has arrived at a dog slide, and with his mobile phone to his ear, he is excitedly talking to the coordinator. Anatol is told that he placed 6th, and only 5 applicants are accepted. Anatol sits down on the dog slide. Very slowly. Trying to hide the fact that his world is collapsing.

Cut. Anatol is lost at the bottom of the dog slide. His phone vibrates: MOM. Then DAD. He dismisses them both. The dog that had sniffed him comes in. Anatol strokes her affectionately, lets her comfort him, and rests his head on hers. Then the dog suddenly starts vomiting, on him, the slide, the floor. Anatol, awakened from his trance, tries to avoid the animal, then to mop up the tomato vomit. 

The dog groomer talks while walking into the room. The dog groomer came in and was horrified to see the vomit that Anatol reflexively tried to hide. she asks if the dog was given tomatoes. Anatol and the dog groomer mop the floor together. Meanwhile, Anatol's phone vibrates again: MOM. The dog groomer
looks at his screen, Anatol follows her gaze, and says:
8.problems: phone call. will the real actor call in? pre recorded? potential overlaps?
8.nurton: NT Dialogue if there are overlaps in scene.

9.description:
Anatol runs from Munich Central Station across the street to his family -- an elegant, present group: his mother MONIKA, his father HERBERT, his sister THERESA (32), in the passenger seat the GRANDMOTHER, the grande dame of the family.
A cheerful greeting, happy birthday wishes from everyone.
9.problems: potential for crushed lavs when hugging. can boom get close?
9.nurton: Dialogue NT if wind or crushed lavs are an issue.

10.description: Anatol squeezes into the back between his mother and sister as the elegant car drives through the city center:
10.problems: getting the mixer close enough + monitoring.
10.nurton: NT Dialogue recorded in car if possible

11.description:
They hurry towards the Italian restaurant, talking about their aunt: A lively, expensive Italian restaurant in Munich's city center.
Anatol's parents and grandmother have already gone inside, Anatol Theresa and [the other person] stay back a little, watching the welcoming arias. At a table in the back sit Uncle Karl, Aunt Stefanie and Anatol's cousin TRISTAN (28). Elegant, stylish, relaxed, as they would have been there forever, while Anatol's family rushed towards them. Anatol and Theresa walk in their direction and whisper to each other: they then greet carl. 

Anatol lets the congratulations of his uncle and aunt wash over him. Tristan, confident and casual, approaches Anatol and greets him very effusively. Hugs him very tightly... what Anatol responds with joyful enthusiasm, sounding like a completely different person: They talk for a page.

12.notes: Theresa swapped to Granny as Theresa has only one line and says "huh?". can swap sender back if needed.
12.description:
A little later: Anatol sits between his uncle and cousin, opposite him his aunt Stefanie, who is sitting next to Theresa. His parents and grandmother are at the other end of the table. Wine is being poured. Uncle Karl peppers his brother-in-law with questions about his building project – subtle rivalry between the men –
while his wife Stefanie emphasizes, “I’m so sorry you can’t come to my charity art opening…” – “Yes, we’re sorry… I’m at an ENT conference in Kassel…”
Anatol turns to his table neighbor Tristan.

Four pages of dialogue. Tristan reveals he's moving back to Munich from his London banking job to be a sustainability consultant. After taklking about it at length, the conversation refocuses to Anatol, who is trying to pivot from 'wanting' to study in Hamburg and hide the fact that he didn't get accepted.

There is a flashback mid scene - likely shot on another shooting day. unsure how this will be planned as of yet.

They discuss Anatol's master thesis, and afterwards Aunt Steffie gives Anatol books as a birthday gift, they're travel guides for Hamburg. After asking if he has somewhere to stay, Anatol says no and Steffie goes to text her friends in Hamburg to ask if he can stay with them. Anatol lets slip that he didn't get into the University.

13.description: Anatol takes a deep breath, trying more and more aggressively to clean the shrinking stain on his trousers with soap.

14.notes: Senders for non-dia aren't essential. Only written under the assumption that they will need to be wearing their mics from the prior scene anyway. May as well keep them on / pre-cable them.
14.description:
Anatol heads back towards the table where they've reached the espresso table. He overhears them talking about the plight of journalism: Steffie is talking about how she is good friends with Carmen Deuflhard (SZ Journalist). She mentions she's going to a charity art opening that he will attend, and that its a shame Anatol can't attend.

Anatol, his ambition is rekindled -- how can he get Stefanie to introduce him to Deuflhard?

15.description:
As Anatol gets up and puts on his coat, he tries to get back with Stefanie -- but then Uncle Karl jovially and a little too hard slaps him on the shoulder. Anatol fakes having birthday plans and tries to find his way out of needing to invite Tristan (which he only just succeeds at).

Tristan laughs and puts on his Barbour jacket. Anatol slings his backpack over his shoulder with relief.
